## What's new
- **Version label in Settings** – a new **About** card shows the running version (`ArrHub v1.1.0`) with links to the release notes and the GitHub repository
- **Update check** – ArrHub checks the latest GitHub release and tells you when a newer version is available, with a *What's new* link (checked every 6 hours, or on demand with *Check for updates*)
- **Version badge** next to the ⚙ Settings tab, highlighted when an update is available
- English and Croatian translations for all of the above

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.1.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept in every case.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
